name: After § 5
title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2025
part_text: 2. Condemns the increasing trend in violations and abuses of human rights across the world, in particular, the unprecedented global backlash against women’s and girls’ rights and gender equality, and the rise in homophobic and anti-trans rhetoric, illustrated by funding cuts, the adoption of discriminatory laws and policies and political attacks, which risks jeopardising decades of progress in Europe and around the world;
